source: cannabinoids_test.go:TestCannabinoidAttribution ("CBD product with trace-THC disclaimer must stay CBD")

raw.title: StarCBD - CBD Oil Pain Relief - 750mg/30ml
raw.description: Pure CBD goodness. Contains less than 0.3% THC as permitted by law.

regression_note: The <0.3% THC legal-compliance disclaimer (trace_thc pattern) must NOT be attributed as dosed THC content — a 'less than 0.3% THC' CBD oil is 750mg of CBD, not a mystery total. This is distinct from the thc_free case (starcbd doesn't say '0% THC' or 'THC-free', it says trace amount is present but below the legal threshold).
